SERVICE AGREEMENT

This Service Agreement is entered into on 1 July 2026 between BrightCloud Hosting LLP ("the Provider") and Meera Textiles ("the Customer").

1. SCOPE OF SERVICES
The Provider shall host and maintain the Customer's online store and provide technical support by email.

2. FEES
The Customer shall pay a fee of Rs. 12,000 per month. Invoices are payable within fifteen (15) days of the invoice date.

3. SERVICE LEVELS
The Provider will make reasonable efforts to keep the store available 99.5% of the time each month. Scheduled maintenance is excluded.

4. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
The Provider's total liability under this agreement shall not exceed the fees paid by the Customer in the preceding one (1) month.

5. TERM AND RENEWAL
This agreement continues for twelve (12) months and renews automatically for further twelve-month periods unless either party gives thirty (30) days' notice before the renewal date.

6. CHANGES
The Provider may change the fees at any time by posting the new fees on its website.
